notes.title: Alder's Blood Update 2.0 just hit the experimental branch!
notes.notes:
Hey Hunters,

The main game just has been updated with a huge amount of new content and enhancements. You can read about it here - https://steamcommunity.com/games/820020/announcements/detail/3021331368161434049

https://store.steampowered.com/app/820020/Alders_Blood/

If you already own Alder's Blood, pick the experimental branch, update the game, launch it and check the new update! If Alder's Blood is not in your library yet, consider giving it a go! ːsteamthumbsupː
